# WWNT Robotics

> WWNT Robotics helps universities, labs and small startups make robot dreams come true — bipedal humanoids, robotic arms, dexterous hands and open-source kits.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://wwnt.ai/): Company overview and featured robots.
- [MicroDuck Parts & Spares](https://wwnt.ai/microduck-accessories.html): Set of MicroDuck Parts (Excluding 3D Plastics Parts) — $479; plus spare Feetech HD1901M servos, IMX219 camera, LSM6DSV16X IMU, VL53L8CX ToF, NP-F550 battery and debug board. 3D-printed parts not included (self-print).
- [Global Supply](https://wwnt.ai/microduck-supply.html): MicroDuck parts sourcing & kitting, authorized FEETECH supply chain, complete robotics ecosystem; DIY kits, spare parts, technical support and educational packages.
- [Pricing / Store](https://wwnt.ai/store.html): Full product catalog and pricing.
- [Open Source](https://wwnt.ai/opensource.html): Open-source community, SDK and simulation demos.

## MicroDuck Parts Kit (product)

- **Name**: Set of MicroDuck Parts (Excluding 3D Plastics Parts)
- **Brand**: WWNT Robotics
- **Price**: $479 USD (Ex-Works)
- **Availability**: Pre-order, 21-day lead time
- **Contents**: Complete electronics + mechanical kit — 15 × Feetech HD1901M TTL bus servos, IMX219 camera, LSM6DSV16X IMU, VL53L8CX ToF, NP-F550 battery, Feetech URT-2 debug board, screws, bearings and adapter cable.
- **3D-printed parts**: Not included — print your own from the open-source files (GitHub).
- **Open source**: GitHub — https://github.com/UnitClaw
